objects.name: Analytic 2254
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Secure Shell (SSH) connection to an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux asset from a source Internet Protocol (IP) address that appeared on the ICS network within a short window and is not in the approved device inventory. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: syslog:auth
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Secure Shell (SSH) connection from source Internet Protocol (IP) address that appeared on Industrial Control Systems (ICS) network within new device window, not in approved device inventory

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Hardware ID inventory of all devices authorized to connect to the ICS network, ideally enforced via NAC/802.1X.
Time window after first network appearance within which access to ICS systems is considered part of the same onboarding/intrusion event.
